title: Kanji instruction entry (0.2)
description: One JSONL line per character-instruction item (K-16, Heisig/WaniKani-style). Language-neutral schema: any pack whose writing system teaches characters by decomposition may use it. The engine drills meaning and reading recognition from the character; it never interprets the language itself. Mnemonics are pack data; AI-drafted ones must carry `generation` provenance and a non-approved `status`.

meanings.description: Meaning prompts in the pack's metalanguage; the meaning-recognition drill's correct answers.

readings.description: Reading prompts; the reading-recognition drill's correct answers.

radicals.description: Decomposition shown as scaffolding before the attempt.

mnemonic.description: Optional mnemonic story; labelled with its review status in the UI.
